title: HOSPES Event Vocabulary
description: Canonical event names for the HOSPES domain. Events are emitted by state transitions and agent actions; they drive workflow triggers, audit trails, and handoffs between capability layers. All event names are dotted lower-case. The human_gates array lists actions that may NEVER be taken by automated logic — a human must initiate or explicitly approve before the event fires.

events.name: person.created
events.description: A new Person record was added to the system.

events.name: person.do_not_contact_set
events.description: The do_not_contact flag was set on a Person. All outreach pipelines halt immediately.

events.name: relationship.edge_created
events.description: A new Relationship edge between two Person records was created.

events.name: relationship.protected
events.description: A Relationship was marked as protected (C4–C5 or manual). Requires relationship_owner approval for any outreach through this edge.

events.name: relationship.followup_due
events.description: A relationship nurture checkpoint has become overdue — a human should review and decide the next step.

events.name: appearance.candidate_created
events.description: A new AppearanceOpportunity was created for a Person on a Show.

events.name: appearance.researching
events.description: Research phase has begun for this opportunity.

events.name: appearance.qualified
events.description: The candidate passed editorial qualification and has an episode thesis.

events.name: appearance.editorial_review
events.description: Opportunity entered the editorial review queue for host approval.

events.name: appearance.approved
events.description: A human (host or designated approver) approved this opportunity for outreach.

events.name: appearance.rejected
events.description: A human rejected this opportunity. Opportunity moves to DECLINED.

events.name: appearance.protected_relationship_flagged
events.description: This opportunity was flagged because it involves a C4–C5 relationship. Halts automated pipeline until relationship_owner grants explicit approval.

events.name: appearance.duplicate_detected
events.description: A duplicate opportunity was detected for the same Person + Show combination.

events.name: contact_route.identified
events.description: A contact route for this opportunity was identified and selected.

events.name: contact_route.verified
events.description: A ContactRoute was verified as active and usable.

events.name: outreach.draft_ready
events.description: The system generated a draft outreach message awaiting human review and approval.

events.name: outreach.approved
events.description: A human explicitly approved the outreach draft for sending.

events.name: outreach.sent
events.description: A human sent the approved outreach message. The system NEVER sends automatically — this event records the human action.

events.name: reply.received
events.description: An inbound reply was detected and logged as a Touchpoint.

events.name: reply.classified
events.description: The inbox triage agent classified a reply into one of the canonical intent classes.

events.name: followup.due
events.description: A scheduled follow-up deadline was reached. Triggers human review if no reply was received.

events.name: booking.interested
events.description: The guest expressed interest in appearing. Opportunity enters INTERESTED state.

events.name: booking.negotiating
events.description: Active negotiation on fees, logistics, or topic scope is underway. Requires human handling.

events.name: booking.proposed
events.description: Specific recording dates/times were proposed to the guest.

events.name: booking.confirmed
events.description: The recording was confirmed with date, time, and studio.

events.name: booking.rescheduled
events.description: A confirmed booking was rescheduled. Prior commitment record updated.

events.name: booking.cancelled
events.description: A confirmed booking was cancelled. Requires human handling if the guest cancelled.

events.name: studio.routed
events.description: A studio was assigned to this opportunity based on city and availability.

events.name: consent.signed
events.description: A consent or release record was signed by the guest.

events.name: guest_intake.completed
events.description: The guest completed intake (care profile, logistics preferences, release form).

events.name: availability.provided
events.description: The guest provided their preferred recording dates through the guest portal.

events.name: preinterview.completed
events.description: The pre-interview call between producer and guest was completed.

events.name: release.complete
events.description: The guest release was fully signed and on file.

events.name: episode.thesis_locked
events.description: The episode thesis was approved by a human and locked for production.

events.name: episode.brief_ready
events.description: The producer research brief for the episode was generated and ready for host review.

events.name: episode.rundown_approved
events.description: The episode rundown/segment plan was approved by a human.

events.name: research.claim_verified
events.description: A research claim in the episode brief was verified against a source.

events.name: recording.ready
events.description: All technical and logistics checks passed; the episode is ready to record.

events.name: recording.completed
events.description: The episode recording session concluded.

events.name: media.ingested
events.description: Raw media was ingested into the canonical media store and an Asset record was created.

events.name: transcript.ready
events.description: A transcript was generated and attached to the Episode.

events.name: segment.identified
events.description: A segment was identified and timestamped within the episode recording.

events.name: commitment.created
events.description: A new Commitment record was created (from detected promise or manual entry).

events.name: commitment.completed
events.description: A Commitment was fulfilled and marked complete.

events.name: commitment.overdue
events.description: A Commitment deadline passed without fulfillment. Triggers human alert.

events.name: gift.approved
events.description: A thank-you gift suggestion was approved by a human above the threshold.

events.name: content_unit.generated
events.description: A ContentUnit was generated by the content engine from an approved Episode.

events.name: content_unit.approved
events.description: A ContentUnit was approved by a human for distribution.

events.name: distribution.dispatched
events.description: A ContentUnit was dispatched to its target platform.

events.name: distribution.delivered
events.description: Delivery of a ContentUnit to its target platform was confirmed.

events.name: episode.published
events.description: The episode was published to all distribution channels.

events.name: correction.appended
events.description: A correction was appended to a published episode. Requires human approval.

events.name: relationship.nurture_due
events.description: A post-episode relationship nurture checkpoint is due. The system may DRAFT a note; a human must send it.

events.name: guest.editorially_approved
events.description: Alias from the transcript handoff vocabulary: a guest candidate was approved editorially.

events.name: guest.research_completed
events.description: Research for a guest candidate was completed and brief is ready.

events.name: draft.edited
events.description: A human edited an AI-generated outreach draft before approving or sending it. Feeds the human-correction metric: revisions per AI draft.

events.name: classification.overridden
events.description: A human overrode the triage agent's classification label for an inbound reply. Feeds the human-correction metric: classification override rate.

human_gates.description: First outreach to any new guest. The system drafts; a human sends. No exceptions.
Any contact through a C4–C5 relationship or a manually protected relationship edge.
Fees, travel reimbursement, accommodations, gifts above threshold, or any monetary commitment.
Any contractual language, release exceptions, or legally binding action.
Any editorial promise about topics, editing, or content removal made to a guest.
A thank-you gift above the pre-approved threshold (dollar amount set in show config).
Any reply classified as AMBIGUOUS, REQUIRES_HUMAN, SOFT_DECLINE (with non-standard context), FEE_REQUEST, TOPIC_CONCERN, or HARD_DECLINE.
Asking a mutual contact to make a warm introduction on behalf of the show.
Cancelling a confirmed recording booking — especially if initiated by the show.
Agreeing to an embargo period, content editing, or removal of published material.
Outreach to guests whose relationship_class, risk_level, or public profile requires elevated care.
Any contact involving government officials, minors, active litigation, or medical matters.
